editorial.summary: Strathfield is a major rail junction with a young, student-heavy population and strong Nepalese, Chinese and Korean communities. Its share houses and unit blocks make it a common first stop for new arrivals.
loves: A major rail junction - three train lines meet here
Student-friendly share houses and unit blocks
A strong Korean, Nepalese and Chinese food scene
thingsToKnow: Rents run higher than neighbouring suburbs further west
editorial.transportNote: Strathfield Station is served by the T1, T2 and T9 lines.
